localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 源质网络适配新版：普通 ME 终端、总线、监视器与电平发射器可直接处理源质，不再需要独立的源质设备。总线可从容器任意面存取。
localized.en_us: Modern AE2 terminals, buses, monitors and level emitters handle essentia directly. Separate essentia variants are unnecessary; buses access containers from any side.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 源质存储已扩充：新增256k存储元件。
localized.en_us: Essentia storage adds a 256k cell tier.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 源质存储已扩充：新增1024k及以上、量子和奇点元件。
localized.en_us: Essentia storage adds 1024k and larger cells, including Quantum and Singularity tiers.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 源质元件新增预览：悬停可查看已存要素和数量。
localized.en_us: Essentia cells show a preview of stored aspects and quantities on hover.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 终端取源质已调整：从网络借取本体空源质瓶装填，无需另造专用安瓿。
localized.en_us: Terminals fill Thaumcraft phials borrowed from network storage; no separate ampoule is needed.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 样板编码适配新版：奥术配方使用 AE 原生样板编码终端；坩埚、注魔和蒸馏使用含物品与源质的处理样板。
localized.en_us: Pattern encoding uses the native AE Pattern Encoding Terminal for arcane recipes and processing patterns containing items and essentia for crucible, infusion and distillation recipes.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 奥术合成新增无线终端：可选择背包法杖支付，逐根尝试完整费用，不合并多根法杖的魔力。
localized.en_us: Wireless Arcane Terminals can use inventory wands. Each wand must cover the entire cost; vis from multiple wands is never combined.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 无线终端新增 AE2WTLib 联动：量子桥卡配合缠绕奇点，可通过已加载且通电的量子桥跨维度连接网络。
localized.en_us: Wireless terminals support AE2WTLib Quantum Bridge Cards: use a paired singularity to connect across dimensions through a loaded, powered quantum bridge.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 无线终端新增魔力充能卡：从同一网络的输入灵气接口为终端内部法杖充能，不给背包法杖充能。
localized.en_us: Wireless Vis Cards recharge the terminal’s internal wand from input vis interfaces on the same network; inventory wands are not charged.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 注魔供应器已增强：普通供应器即可向 ME 合成 CPU 请求缺失源质，不再另设高级供应器。
localized.en_us: Ordinary Infusion Providers can request missing essentia from ME crafting CPUs; a separate Advanced Provider is no longer needed.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 源质供应器已增强：缺少所需源质时可向 ME 合成 CPU 自动下单。
localized.en_us: Essentia Providers can request missing essentia from ME crafting CPUs.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 奥术装配室已调整：制造不再消耗银树权杖；运行时放入真实法杖支付魔力，应用杖端、杖型与装备减免。
localized.en_us: Arcane Assemblers no longer consume a Silverwood Scepter during construction. Insert a real wand for crafting; its cap, wand-type and equipment discounts apply.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 灵气接口连接已修正：绑定的是输入接口本身；拆除后在原位放新接口必须重新绑定。
localized.en_us: Vis links bind to a specific input interface; a replacement at the same position must be linked again.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 源质谐振仓已修正：网络暂时拒收的能量会保留；新增界面可查看燃料和发电状态。
localized.en_us: Vibration Chambers retain energy that the network cannot accept. A new status menu shows fuel and generation.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 无线傀儡适配新版：支持新版 Forge 流体运输；按实际运输量结算，断网时保留携带物。
localized.en_us: Wireless golems support modern Forge fluids, account for actual transferred amounts and retain carried resources when disconnected.

localized.zh_cn: 神秘能源
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics

localized.zh_cn: 来自神秘能源的终端修改：AE 通用终端新增“显示源质”资源筛选。
localized.en_us: Thaumic Energistics adds a “Show Essentia” resource filter to ordinary AE terminals.
